current_answer: Founderland’s Q4 Forward Grant offers selected eligible founders €10,000, but applying costs €50, non-refundable. Its linked waiver page says all ten waivers for this cycle are allocated. Check eligibility and the current form before paying.

catalogue_card.question: Is Founderland’s €10,000 grant free to apply for?
catalogue_card.text: No. The Q4 application costs €50, non-refundable. Its linked waiver page says all ten current-cycle waivers are allocated; check the strict founder and ownership rules before paying.

summary: Founderland lists a Q4 2026 window through 31 December, 23:59 Europe/Berlin, for eligible women-of-colour founders in Europe and the UK.
The business must be at least 50% women-owned; a selected founder may receive a €10,000 equity-free grant, not a guaranteed award.
The €50 application fee is non-refundable, including for ineligible applications. The linked waiver page says current-cycle waivers are exhausted.
